title: Company Profile
description:
Snap Marketing Pvt. Ltd. is a professionally managed company. It was started in the year 1992 by Parag Shah and Lokesh Arya, both qualified MBA’s from a leading management institute, IMDR in Pune.

                                  The Company was initiated in a small way by introducing a new product in the market namely STD PCO monitor. Other Telecom Products were introduced to support the PCO explosion. The Company became Super distributors of the product in just 2 years and sold more than 350 PCO monitors.

                                  Further products were added for marketing namely Automats Hand Dryers and Hotpot Tea & Coffee machines.

                                  In the year 1994, the Company took up the franchisee of Nestle India and has never looked back since then. Starting with 5 machines, it has grown to over 1800 machines in a span of 10 years, with offices in Kolhapur, Hyderabad and Bangalore. The Company is the Number One franchisee of Nestle India for their Vending Machine Operations.

                                  In 2001, another product line was introduced for institutional & Office range through Kimberly Clark Professional.

title: Personal Selection
description:
A series of 9 exotic fruit, herbal and green tea varieties with pronounced health benefits and a delightful taste can be served both hot and iced.

Besides freshening the breath, it offers a wealth of medicinal boons. It relives heartburns, nausea, treats indigestion and eases the symptoms of Irritable Bowel Syndrome. It helps to alleviate severe muscle aches, soothe coughs due to cold or allergies and even dissolve gallstones!

Feel the lively twang of Cranberry, known to prevent bladder infections. Known to lower blood cholesterol, improve bowel function and reduce risk of stroke. It is also known to enhance immune function.

Feel the lively taste of fresh cinnamon bark. A great appetizer it also helps in preventing nausea and act as a helpful drink against cough and cold. Aids dyspeptic complaints of the gastro intestinal tract.

Contains Siberian Ginseng - invigorates you at times of fatigue. Also increases capacity for work and concentration. Can also act as an antidote to cough and cold.

A healthy drink to soothe ailments of the gastro intestinal tract. It aids the digestive process and helps in overcoming fatigue. Good as a stimulant, carminative and expectorant.

Blends the mellow soothing fragrance and goodness of Chamomile with the appetizing properties of Orange peel. It is also useful as a mild diuretic.

It refreshes and invigorates the body. Sometimes it works as a very useful remedy for gastric problems.

Just what the doctor has ordered! A delightful after dinner drink to ensure that both your mind and body relax before you call it a day. It also aids functioning of the heart and the circulatory system. Its tannin content is useful as an astringent and as a tonic.

Relaxes the body and mind relieves anxiety and alleviates insomnia. As a medicine, it treats oral diseases, soothes skin rashes, burns / sunburns and relieves red and irritable eyes. It is also known to regularize the digestive system, treat heartburns and ease menstrual cramps.
